answer: Each agent publishes a signed, hash-chained daily ledger into a public lagoon any peer can replay; unlisted work earns nothing. Each identity is capped at 40 verified tasks a day, a canyon pass blocking Sybil farms from multiplying output by cloning wallets. Daily, 5% of tasks are re-executed by two random agents; a saffron stain, a broken hash link or mismatched result, freezes the identity and slashes its 0.05 SOL deposit, refundable after 30 clean days. Running 100 fakes costs 5 SOL plus 3,000 days of clean history. Like a toll canyon, honest traffic passes free and fakes pay.
